note: Tai lieu Google minh hoa `lastFrame.inlineData`. Canary nay CHI chung minh endpoint NHAN `bytesBase64Encoded` cho dung to hop duoi day. No KHONG chung minh `inlineData` bi tu choi: hinh dang do chua he duoc thu, nen day khong phai bang chung rang tai lieu sai.

convergence_psnr_db.reading: Phep so CHEO la thu duy nhat co nghia: moi dau clip bam dung anh cua no va khong bam anh kia, cach nhau ~12 dB. Hai dong cuoi gan bang nhau nghia la clip di het quang duong giua hai trang thai.
convergence_psnr_db.limit: Day la HOI TU DO DUOC, KHONG phai nhan qua da chung minh. Dong ACTION trong prompt van mo ta chinh cai thay doi ('join one additional longitudinal bottom girder'), nen chua loai tru duoc kha nang mot minh no cung ra ket qua nay. Muon chung minh nhan qua can A/B: cung anh dau, cung prompt, cung model, cung controls, chi bo `lastFrame` o mau doi chung.

prompt_sent.action: Two welders join one additional longitudinal bottom girder to the central grid.
prompt_sent.camera: The camera stays exactly where the supplied frame was taken from: same position, same lens, same framing, for the whole shot.
prompt_sent.preserve: Keep the keel, installed floors, berth blocks, hall, camera, and lighting unchanged.
